blocks.text: Rockwell Land Corp. has doubled its retail footprint, giving its loyal patrons more spaces to shop and more reasons to stay. Following its acquisition of Alabang Town Center late last year, the property developer now has close to 200,000 sqm of gross leasable area (GLA), doubling a retail portfolio that began with the Power Plant Mall in Rockwell Center Makati. That growing presence stretches to Santolan Town Plaza, retail strips at The Grove and The Arton, a retail pavilion in Nara Residences, and soon, two more malls in Pampanga and Bacolod City.
